Product Features

  • Size and Adaptability: The total size is 175 x 38 x 45 cm, with enough length, suitable for TVs up to 75 inches. It provides a stable hold for large TVs and creates a coordinated audiovisual center for the living room.
  • Extensive storage combination: 2 L-shaped cabinets with 1 drawer, plus a semi-open storage area in the middle and a large flat surface on the top, multiple storage spaces can be classified to store DVDs, remote controls, decorations, etc., so that the living room is no longer cluttered.
  • Clever idea for semi-open storage: The semi-open area, hollowed out in the middle, is good for setting up set-top boxes and can also be used to display small decorative items. This not only ensures easy access to the items, but also increases the display value of the space.
  • Intelligent LED Lighting Atmosphere: LED light strips with mobile phone app control can adjust color and brightness as you like, creating an immersive atmosphere when watching movies, creating a sense of vibrancy during gatherings, and easily changing the scene atmosphere.
  • High-gloss look design: The cabinet doors, drawer tops and front drawbars are equipped with high-gloss technology, and the white appearance is modern and bright, which not only enhances the visual refinement, but is also easy to clean and maintain, and everyday stains can be removed with a single wipe.
  • Material and Load Capacity: Made of chipboard, the total recommended load capacity is 45kg. It can carry TVs and various objects stably. It is sturdy and durable, and it does not deform easily even after prolonged use.
  • Clever details and design: The top tabletop is narrower at the bottom and gives the room a more layered feel through the LED lighting. Under the light, the objects placed on them look more noble and give the living room an artistic atmosphere.
  • The stand model is easy to clean: The stand design has no hygienic dead corners. With daily cleaning, the floor and surrounding areas can be easily cleaned, making cleaning the living room more thorough and worry-free.
  • Variety of styles: The simple white look, combined with high-gloss and light elements, goes well with different living styles such as modern and light luxury and can thus become a visual highlight in the living room.
  • Note: This product comes in two packages and may arrive with a time delay. Please make sure both packages have arrived before assembly.
